20261121-physics-g11-1.material: [H2 Binciken Fiziks (Babba)] Binciken motsin faduwa kyauta dangane da Ƙarfi, motsi da dangantaka. An saki wani abu daga tsayawa a cikin fanko a karkashin maganadisu $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Menene gudun $v$ da tazarar faduwa $h$ bayan $t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g11-1.s.s1.prompt: [H2 Binciken Fiziks (Babba)] Binciken motsin faduwa kyauta dangane da Ƙarfi, motsi da dangantaka. An saki wani abu daga tsayawa a cikin fanko a karkashin maganadisu $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Menene gudun $v$ da tazarar faduwa $h$ bayan $t = 3\text{ s}$?
20261121-physics-g11-1.s.s1.explain:
Mataki 1: Gudu $v = gt = 9.8 \times 3 = 29.4\text{ m/s}$.
Mataki 2: Tazarar $h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0.5 \times 9.8 \times 9 = 44.1\text{ m}$.
Mataki 3: Don haka $v = 29.4\text{ m/s}$ kuma $h = 44.1\text{ m}$.

20261119-physics-g12.s.s1.explain:

Mataki 3: Don haka gaggawa ita ce $5\text{ m/s}^2$ kuma aiki $40\text{ J}$.
